snippet.title: Stormforge Extended Trailer - Play Demo Now!
snippet.description:
Wishlist and Follow on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2826790/Stormforge/
Subscribe to be the first to playtest: http://www.playstormforge.com/
Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/playstormforge

You are Stormforged, with the ability to brave and harness power from magical storms. Explore, fight, forage, craft, build, and defeat bosses in this epic, highly moddable, open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players.
